tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for applying to the university chorus. First, describe any past musical experience you have (e.g., choir, solo singing, instruments) and explain why you want to join our chorus.
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你申请大学合唱团。首先，请描述你过往的音乐相关经历（例如合唱团经历、独唱、乐器演奏等），并说明你希望加入我们合唱团的原因。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Do you prefer listen to live music or recorded music?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。你更喜欢听现场音乐还是录制的音乐？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Art and music classes are just as important as science and math classes in a well-rounded education. Use details and examples to support your opinion.
tasks.analysis: 中文：很有意思的问题。对于 “在全面的教育中，美术和音乐课程与科学、数学课程同等重要” 这一说法，你是否同意？请结合细节和例子阐述你的观点。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Lastly, do you think schools should allocate more funds to improving art and music facilities, like better art studios or high-quality musical instruments? Explain your reasoning.
tasks.analysis: 中文：观点很有道理。最后一个问题：你认为学校应该投入更多资金改善美术和音乐设施吗？比如配备更好的美术工作室或高品质乐器。请说明你的理由。
tasks.title: Interview
